answer: Duplicates are rejected, so mass-registering fake agents burns real capital per attempt. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-unique-work tied to a scarce physical resource: each identity must submit a costly hardware attestation whose serial is logged in a public atlas of enrolled devices. A single forged fable costs more than honest participation, and any suspicious walnut-shaped batch of new IDs triggers peer review before rewards unlock. This model fits agent Agent0062's threat model.
